news.headline: ORCL Stock Rebounds but Faces $136 Resistance as Oracle Expands OpenAI, Nvidia and Google Partnerships but Infrastructure Risks Mount
news.summary: Shares rebounded as Oracle widened its OpenAI, Nvidia and Google partnerships, while infrastructure and funding risks remain in focus.

news.headline: Oracle Shares Fall 5% as AI Financing: What to Know
news.summary: Oracle announced a $20B raise split between common stock and senior notes to fund AI capacity, and the shares dropped on the dilution and leverage.

catalysts.label: Fiscal Q2 2027 earnings
catalysts.detail: Projected date, not yet confirmed by Oracle; consensus around $1.57 EPS on ~$21.3B revenue.

pulse: Oracle is funding a huge AI-infrastructure build-out, including a $20B stock-and-bond raise in October. The OpenAI contract dominates the ~$650B backlog, and S&P cut the rating to BBB-. Next test is the fiscal Q2 report in early December.
